findings.title: Diff adds demo-suite wiring but not the referenced build/test files
findings.message: This diff introduces examples/demo-suite as a new directory (README.md and LICENSE are new files), but the module's implementation is absent from the diff. The new wiring in scripts/check.sh, scripts/check-example.sh, and the stage-dispatch test all reference files that are not present in this change: bundle_tools_test.py, build.sh, Launch.command, run.sh, release/version.json, and the Go module sources (go.mod, hub). If this diff is applied as shown, the checks will fail: cd into the directory succeeds (README/LICENSE create it), but `python3 -B bundle_tools_test.py` fails with 'No such file or directory' and `go test ./...` fails with 'go.mod file not found', breaking the offscreen stage, the examples stage, and check-stages_test.py's assertion that 'python3 -B bundle_tools_test.py' appears in the stage log.
findings.suggestion: Include the full examples/demo-suite module (go.mod with checkout-relative replace directives, Go sources, build.sh, Launch.command, run.sh, bundle_tools_test.py, release/version.json) in this change, or land it before/with the scripts/check.sh and scripts/check-example.sh wiring so the referenced files exist when the checks run.
findings.evidence: (cd "$VELLUM_REPO_ROOT/examples/demo-suite" && python3 -B bundle_tools_test.py && go test -race -tags offscreen ./... && go vet -tags offscreen ./...)

findings.title: LICENSE copyright year 2026 is likely incorrect for a file created now
findings.message: The new MIT license file carries a 2026 copyright year. Every other newly created file in this change describes a current migration ('Migrated the existing external demo hub into examples/demo-suite'), so a future-dated year is likely a typo that will be copied into future distributions of the suite.
findings.suggestion: Verify the intended year (and holder name spelling) against the repository's other LICENSE files and correct it before merging, e.g. 'Copyright (c) 2025 Davin Hills'.

findings.title: Untagged go test/go vet in examples stage may miss demo-suite tests gated behind the offscreen tag
findings.message: The examples stage runs `go test -race ./...` and `go vet ./...` in examples/demo-suite without build tags, while the module's own documented checks (examples/demo-suite/README.md and the new check.sh line) use `-tags offscreen`. If the demo-suite Go test files are gated behind the offscreen build tag (as the README's check commands suggest), the untagged run will either compile nothing ('no test files') and silently pass, or fail outright if any package sources are tag-constrained. Either way the examples stage provides no real coverage of this module.
findings.suggestion: Confirm the demo-suite package and tests build and pass without tags (they are expected to, per the module README's use of vellum.Version in the hub), or move demo-suite out of the untagged loop and rely on the offscreen-tagged checks in scripts/check.sh so the stage does not report a false green.
